case_number: 2023 INSC 864; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 5968, 5969, 5970 OF 2023 (Arising out of SLP (C) No 18100, 18574, 19227 of 2023)

parties.respondent: Macawber Beekay Pvt. Ltd. and Others

summary: Public procurement dispute: pre-qualification criteria for ash handling plant contract; interpretation of technical requirements Clauses 01.01.01-01.01.03; eligibility of bidder with Chinese partner post-GFR 2017 Rules 144(xi) amendment restricting border-sharing countries; whether consortium agreement satisfied design/engineering requirements; High Court set aside Single Judge order quashing LoI; standard: strict compliance with tender conditions; procurement process validity upheld; pre-qualification disqualification justified.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; LoI to appellant restored; respondent's bid not considered.
